messages:
Maya: quick sync — new q6b-int4 build landed on staging and we’re seeing regressions on long-form summarization prompts (PS v3). ~3% ROUGE-L drop vs fp16 baseline. can people help assemble an edgecase promptset and refresh the golden?
Ravi: where are you seeing the 3%? dashboard or local run?
Maya: dashboard -> /dashboards/infra/quant-compare. filter model=q6b-int4, baseline=q6b-fp16, dataset=longsumm_v3. i also exported the failing IDs to s3: s3://redwood-qa/q6b-int4/longsumm_v3/failures_2026-03-20.csv
Elena: noted. i can run a focused rollout of the quant-compare harness over the 10k candidate prompts. run this locally:
```
python infra/eval/quant_compare.py --model q6b-int4 --baseline q6b-fp16 \
  --prompts data/promptsets/longsumm_v3.jsonl --out /tmp/qcomp.jsonl --seed 42
```
will collect raw generations + metrics.
Jon: label ops heads-up — if we flag a golden refresh we need ~200 golden items curated (50 edgecases + 150 anchors). current labeler capacity is 30/day unless we re-prioritize. @Maya how urgent?
Maya: target is next release canary next Wed. so 200 usable gold by Tue EOD would be ideal. if labelers can't hit it we can curate a temporary microgolden of 75 critical.
Ravi: on dedupe: the failures include many near-duplicates and paraphrases. recommend running fuzzy-hash dedupe before sending to labelers. i can push a dedupe job: `tools/curation/dedupe.py --input failures.csv --threshold 0.82 --out failures_dedup.csv`
Elena: also watch tokenizer drift — q6b-int4 uses tokenizer v2 and some long inputs truncate differently. small difference in context length handling may explain some ROUGE gap. i can diff token counts and attach a sample.
ci-bot: test:quant-compare q6b-int4 vs q6b-fp16 — 2026-03-20T14:12:08Z — failures=312 / 10000, mean_delta=-0.031 
Jon: for golden selection: pick 50 highest delta failures (ROUGE drop) + 25 representative paraphrase clusters + 25 low-frequency intent samples. i'll prepare a spreadsheet and tag with `needs-dedupe` / `needs-deid` flags.
Maya: perfect. next steps: (1) @Ravi run dedupe job and produce failures_dedup.csv by EOD (2) @Elena run tokenizer diff and attach top 20 mismatch examples (3) @Jon create golden spreadsheet and request 75 microgolden if labelers can't scale. i'll kick off the eval harness and post the link when done. :thumbsup:
Ravi: starting dedupe now, ETA 3h. will upload to s3 path and ping here.
Elena: tokenizer diffs posted: s3://redwood-qa/q6b-int4/tokenizer-diffs/2026-03-20/ — found 18 truncation anomalies, 6 of which overlap with high delta failures.
Maya: thanks. If we see the regressions mostly explained by truncation/dedupe, we can adjust the runtime tokenizer mapping + patch quant kernels. if not, we'll escalate to quant team.
Jon: added spreadsheet and asked labelers to block 48hrs. spreadsheet link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/golden/QA-987 (private)
ci-bot: deploy:staging q6b-int4 — metrics snapshot saved to /artifacts/q6b-int4/2026-03-20-14-45.json
Maya: closing loop — everyone please add any candidate adversarial prompts to the `longsumm-regen` thread in prompt-curation. i'll re-run comparisons after dedupe output. thanks all.
